text: {"name":"wlc_ps_disable_cfm","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Handles a validated power-save-disable confirmation, decrements the pending count, clears selected entry flags when the count reaches zero, and sends the completion message.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"result":"disable_context","i":"entry","v6":"remaining_count"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Pending-state byte cleared before sending the completion message."},{"offset":2,"meaning":"Destination task identifier used for the completion message."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Entry flags word; bits 1–3 are cleared when the entry gates match."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Pending-confirmation counter in the disable context, decremented toward zero."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"List head pointer in the entry-list owner."},{"offset":106,"meaning":"Entry gate byte that must be zero before its flags are updated."},{"offset":108,"meaning":"Entry gate byte that must be nonzero before its flags are updated."}]}
